title: mps-silent-failures: sweep harness, guard and results for silent failures of PyTorch's MPS backend at the 2^32 boundary
description:
Code, guard and raw results for the paper Silent Failures Beyond the 32-Bit Index Range: A Differential Characterization of Large-Tensor Matrix Multiplication in PyTorch's MPS Backend.

PyTorch's MPS backend returns wrong values without an error for batched matrix multiplication on tensors with more than 2^32 elements, in every PyTorch release from 2.4.1 to 2.14.0 that was tested, and the backward pass can return wrong gradients while the forward pass is correct. This record contains the boundary sweep harness (v2/scan.py, v2/worker.py), the raw results of every run with their manifests for two machines and two macOS versions and for a CUDA control (v2/results/raw/), the script that compares the hosts run by run (v2/compare_rows.py), the analysis scripts, a guard that stops any MPS operation touching 2^32 or more elements (guard/mps_guard.py), the code and results of the first arXiv version including the first-pass suite and the case study on a public sentiment classifier (v1/), and the paper (paper.pdf).

The code, the guard and the result files are released under the MIT License. The paper (paper.pdf) is licensed under CC BY 4.0.
